description: This is a Perl module implementing a class that ties a hash to a YAML file for caching purposes within the Git::SVN::Memoize namespace. It provides methods for loading, storing, fetching, and dumping cached data in YAML format, and implements the TieHash interface.

classes.name: Git::SVN::Memoize::YAML
classes.description: A Perl class that implements a tied hash stored in a YAML file for memoization caching in the Git::SVN::Memoize namespace.

methods.name: TIEHASH
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the tied hash object, loading existing data from a YAML file if it exists.

methods.name: STORE
methods.description: Stores a value associated with a key in the cache, updating the internal hash.

methods.name: FETCH
methods.description: Retrieves a value associated with a key from the cache.

methods.name: EXISTS
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the cache.

methods.name: DESTROY
methods.description: Dumps the current hash data to the YAML file when the object is destroyed.

methods.name: SCALAR
methods.description: Returns the number of keys in the hash.

methods.name: FIRSTKEY
methods.description: Provides a placeholder for the first key in the tied hash.

methods.name: NEXTKEY
methods.description: Provides a placeholder for the next key in the tied hash iteration.
